We work in an IT company and the there is no Masjid nearby hence we pray in the rest room provided by the company which is also used for meetings and conferences. My question 1. Is our Namaaz valid if we pray without a Namaaz rug as the room is also frequented by other people wearing shoes? Your soonest reply shall be appreciated. 2402 views Q. jamaat faud ho jane par, kya hum usi masjid me jamaat bana sakte hai? bahot se log kahte hai ke masjid ke sahen me pad sakte hai, kya yeh sahi hai? sawab utna hi milenga jinohne waqt par jamaat se namaaz padi ho. 3738 views Q. In lieu of below fatwa we have asked the same two months earlier with Moulana/Mufti Anees Sb of chouhan bangar,Jafrabad & he told that " Ise Momool na banaye lekin jamat e sani agar kabhi kabhi karni ho to kar sakte hai, aur uske liye main mussallah chor kar kahi bhi jamat e sani kar sakte hai aur yeh jamat bina Ehqamat ke karni hogi, Imam bina takbeer ke niyat bandh le. Now please see above lines and clarify the same. Jaza kallah previously Asked: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. and Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) Knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband 2286 views Q. Assalaam Alaikum. My question is that if I have joined the Jamaat in Fourth Rakah in Zuhar prayer, and after offering Salaam by Imam, in which sequence will I recite the Surah other than Surah Fatiha in order to complete my prayer? 2834 views Q. From last two years I recite Surah Fathiha, even I am praying behind IMAM. Is this true practice. I heard when IMAM read one should listen, If IMAM don't one should recite SURAH Fatiha. Please guide me. 3109 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 160542 Country: BD Title: Can I perform umari qaza salah after Asr salah? Question: Can I perform umari qaza salah after Asr salah? Answer ID: 160542 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 834/777/M=7/1439) Yes, you may perform. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
